plot_summary: John Quinn is the protagonist. On Monday, July 22, 2024 at 11:30 am, Apricot Sweeney were involved. John plans an expensive surprise dinner date for his girlfriend on Thursday  1. John wants to surprise Apricot with a romantic dinner at a Michelin star restaurant called Chef's Bite. 2. John has an iMessage correspondence with the restaurant to book a table for two. 3. This results in an extended back and forth of suggesting possible times since the restaurant is heavily booked, but finally agreeing on a suitable day and time on Thursday late evening. 4. John also creates an event, at the time agreed with the restaurant, mentioning a low key greek restaurant that is next door to the Michelin one and invites Apricot to it, without any mention of the real restaurant since any mention of Chef's Bite will ruin the surprise.
